reason: I already pay for Spark, Todoist and Calendly and they work fine together. My month-end invoicing runs off a spreadsheet and nothing's actually broken, so I'm not giving up a weekend to move clients, notes and tasks into a new app.
objection: Migrating is a weekend I don't have, and if it doesn't stick I've lost that time and have to move everything back.
would_change_my_mind: A one-click import from Todoist and my client spreadsheet that has me running in under an hour, plus it replacing Calendly so I'm actually cutting a subscription, not adding one.
